meta.title: Scandia Jomtien Beach | Beautiful rooms near the beach
meta.description: Scandia Beach Hotel — 48 rooms about 200 meters from Jomtien Beach, Soi 7. Outdoor pool, coffee shop, and front desk. Book: booking@scandiajomtienbeach.com
hero.title: Scandia Jomtien Beach
hero.lead: Scandia is located just 200 meters from the beautiful Jomtien sand beach. With 48 beautiful rooms and a swimming pool, your stay is made for relaxing.
float.a.span: Coffee shop · outdoor pool · front desk
float.b.span: A/C · flat-screen TV · fridge · private bath
alt.hero: Jomtien Beach near Scandia Beach Hotel
alt.pool: Scandia Beach Hotel outdoor swimming pool
loc.band: Located on Jomtien Beach Soi 7 — just 200 meters from the beautiful Jomtien sand beach. Welcome to Scandia Beach Hotel.
rooms.label: Rooms & suites
rooms.title: Nice & clean suites
rooms.lead: Every suite features a private bathroom and shower, air conditioning, a flat-screen TV with English and Thai channels, and a fridge.
feat.bath.p: Private bathroom and shower in every suite.
feat.ac.p: Stay cool with air conditioning in every room.
feat.tv.p: English and Thai channels on a flat-screen TV.
feat.fridge.p: In-room fridge for drinks and essentials.
feat.iron.p: Iron and ironing board placed in the room for guest convenience.
feat.wifi.p: Wireless Fiber Internet in rooms. Complimentary for guests who book through the hotel’s own website.
feat.water.p: Tap water is not potable; complimentary bottled water is supplied daily.
rooms.twin.p: The only twin-bedded configuration noted on the FAQ.
rooms.deluxe.p: Can stay 4 people. There are no dedicated quadruple rooms.
rooms.extra.p: Other rooms can be converted to a triple by placing an extra bed (THB 150). No inter-connecting rooms.
rooms.nonsmoke.p: Non-smoking rooms on request, subject to availability.

about.label: About us
about.title: Welcome to Scandia Beach Hotel
about.lead: Scandia offers a range of facilities and services for a comfortable Jomtien stay — polished from the hotel’s published About Us page.
about.reception.p: Lobby reception with warm Thai hospitality. Published hours note 24-hour reception historically, with COVID-era hours listed as 9 am–11 pm.
about.security.p: CCTV surveillance, smoke detectors, and sprinklers. 12-hour reception, maintenance, and security services listed on About Us.
about.parking.p: Free public parking at Rompho / Romhoo Market near Scandia (About Us: ~75 m; FAQ: ~200 m). Confirm on arrival.
about.fitness.p: Nearby fitness option about 70 meters from Scandia — 50 baht per time. Opening hours listed 8:00 am–10:00 pm.
about.massage.p: Massage in your room, 10:00 am–10:00 pm — book at reception.
svc.chillz: Chillz Restaurant (listed NOT OPEN UNDER COVID on About Us)
svc.roomService: Room service (9:00 am–10:00 pm per FAQ — not 24-hour)
svc.business: Business Center services (listed NOT OPEN UNDER COVID on About Us)
svc.parking: Free parking nearby (~75–200 m at Rompho Market)

fac.title: Relax at the pool — then explore Pattaya

fac.wifi: Fiber Wi-Fi (complimentary on direct web bookings)

faq.label: FAQ
faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.lead: Recovered from the hotel’s published FAQ page (live URL currently 404 — content from public index).
faq.q1: What are check-in and check-out times?
faq.a1: Check-in time is 2:00 pm. Check-out time is 12:00 noon.
faq.a2: Yes — on request and subject to availability.
faq.q3: Do you have twin, triple and quadruple rooms?
faq.a3: Only the Superior Twin Suite is twin-bedded. Other rooms can be converted to a triple with an extra bed. There are no quadruple rooms, but Deluxe Suites can stay 4 people.
faq.q5: What is the cost of an extra bed?
faq.a6: Yes — book a day in advance. Cost is THB 250 per hour.
faq.q7: Where is breakfast served and at what time?
faq.a7: Breakfast is served at the restaurant next to the lobby on the ground floor, from 8:00 am to 10:30 am.
faq.a8: No — room service is available from 9:00 am to 10:00 pm.
faq.a9: Free public parking at Rompho Market near Scandia Beach Hotel (FAQ lists ~200 m; About Us lists ~75 m).
faq.q10: What is the length and depth of your pool?
faq.a11: Hairdryers in all rooms. Iron and ironing board are placed in the room for guest convenience.
faq.q12: Is tap water safe to drink?
faq.a12: No — tap water in Thailand is not potable. Complimentary bottled water is supplied to rooms daily.
faq.a13: Yes — wireless Fiber Internet. Complimentary for guests who book through the hotel’s own website.
faq.q14: Are dual telephone sockets available in rooms?
faq.a14: Dual telephone sockets are available only for the reception.
nearby.label: Nearby attractions
nearby.title: Around Soi 7 & Jomtien
nearby.lead: From the hotel’s Nearby Attractions page (live URL currently 404 — content from public index).
nearby.shop.p: 7-Eleven 24-hour stores around the corner; minimart about 50 m. Food mart and Mini Big C about 1 km. Central Festival in Pattaya downtown via 24/7 baht-bus on beach road (~10 baht).
nearby.dine.p: Many bars and restaurants next to the hotel — Thai plates mingled with contemporary Western flavours.
nearby.spa.p: Many massage shops & salons next to Scandia. Partner at The Train Resort (~2 km) — free shuttle for sauna & spa and mini golf (200 baht per person for all day); ask at reception.
nearby.public.p: Bangkok Bank ATM ~100 m; pharmacy ~100 m; foot market and bar complex within easy walking distance (~200 m).
